name: Little Gobby Goblin
subtitle: Psychic • Explosive • Speed-Powered Chaos Monkey
description: Little Gobby as you've never seen him before: psychic, fast, and far more dangerous than any goblin has the right to be. Turns out the little guy has been hiding a few… surprises.

traits.name: Explosive Momentum.
traits.entries: When Gobby moves at least 20 feet, the next attack deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.entries: Little Gobby can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of his turns.

traits.name: Minor Magic
traits.entries: Little Gobby knows one cantrip: minor illusion. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 8).

actions.name: Bite
actions.entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
